comment: Source read at commit d9cf8d7, which is the last commit to touch src and whose plugin.json matches the installed 2.0.4 byte for byte; the repository head 9b2abff only edits the README. Three commits carry 2.0.4, and the installed build settles which: process opens by storing args.sampleRate into the curSampleRate field that d9cf8d7 added and c5eddc1 does not have. FOUR INPUTS EXIST IN THE ENUM AND HAVE NO JACK. DRIFTSPEED_INPUT, DRIFTTYPE_INPUT, VOLTSCALE_INPUT and FILTERTYPE_INPUT (indices 6, 8, 9 and 10) are declared, are never given a configInput and are never added as PortWidgets; nothing in process reads them. They get no line and no tag. THE FIVE CV JACKS REPLACE THEIR SLIDERS. Each one calls setValue on its own parameter, so the slider is dragged to the voltage and cannot be moved by hand while the cable is in; the maker's README says as much, calling it an override. INVERT IS ON WHEN THE MODULE IS ADDED. configParam gives INVERT_PARAM a default of 1 while the widget is a momentary LEDButton, and process feeds that straight to a dsp::BooleanTrigger, which sees a false-to-true edge on the first sample and sets invertVoltage. onReset clears it, but Rack does not call onReset when a module is created from the browser, so a fresh module comes up with the lamp lit and every step's sign reversed. AMP defaults to 0, and every step voltage is multiplied by it, so the module is silent on arrival as well. Small things: the Filter slider has a dead band, anything between -0.02 and 0.02 reading as zero; Filter Offset is configured 0 to 16 but clamped to the step count minus one and floored, so its top is unreachable at any step count below 17 and it is ignored entirely on the Noise Algo filter; the drift accumulator is scaled by the sample rate in onSampleRateChange with a guard against a zero rate. The panel prints BASE, RANGE, DRIFT, AMP, FILTER, TYPE, SCALE, STYLE, STEPS, SPEED, INVERT, OFFSET, TRIG IN, RESET IN, MAIN, FILTER, DRONE and TRIG; the maker's own parameter names are longer and are what the tooltips show. The switch positions run bottom to top in the order configSwitch lists them, so the SCALE switch reads ±5V at the bottom and 5V at the top, matching the panel's markings. Every input and output is read or written on channel 0 only.
